name: Ebisawa Reiko
source:
She is [url=/c65594]Kuzuhara Mikiko[/url]'s younger sister. She is a teacher of the school attended by the twin sisters Mai and Yuu.

She is serious and has a reputation for her guidance of students. Because she is an intelligent beauty, she is the center of attention and an object of admiration among the students.

Yuuichi discovers that, under the guise of “student guidance,” she is secretly having sexual intercourse with several students, and he uses this as leverage to discipline her.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ002522.html]DLsite[/url]]
